# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Repository Overview

This repository is focused on fire protection debugging and testing (消防调试类). It serves as a collection or framework for fire protection system debugging utilities and classes.

## Project Structure

- **README.md**: Main repository documentation in Chinese
- **.github/**: GitHub configuration and Copilot instructions

## Development Guidelines

### Language and Localization
- Primary language for documentation and code comments should be Chinese, as this is a Chinese-language project
- Code should follow standard programming conventions while maintaining Chinese documentation

### Code Standards
- Write clear, maintainable code with appropriate comments in Chinese
- Follow consistent naming conventions
- Include proper error handling and logging

### Documentation
- Keep README.md updated with project changes
- Document all major features and modules
- Include usage examples where applicable

### Testing
- Add tests for new functionality when applicable
- Ensure existing tests pass before submitting changes
- Document test cases and expected behavior

### Pull Requests
- Provide clear descriptions of changes in Chinese
- Reference related issues if applicable
- Ensure all changes are tested before submission

## Working with Copilot Coding Agent

When working on issues in this repository:
1. Review existing code structure and documentation
2. Maintain consistency with existing code style
3. Update documentation to reflect changes
4. Test thoroughly before completing tasks
5. Use Chinese for user-facing documentation and comments

## Best Practices

- Keep changes focused and minimal
- Maintain backward compatibility when possible
- Follow semantic versioning for releases
- Write comprehensive commit messages in Chinese
